summary: to_nice_json parameters, including indent (default 4) and sort_keys (default true), plus allow_nan, check_circular, ensure_ascii, preprocess_unsafe, skipkeys and vault_to_text.
questions: What indentation does to_nice_json use by default?
How do I change the indent of to_nice_json?

answer_card.title: to_nice_json parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `indent` (default **4**)
- `sort_keys` (default **true**)
- `allow_nan` (default true), `check_circular` (default true), `ensure_ascii` (default true)
- `preprocess_unsafe` (default true), `skipkeys` (default false), `vault_to_text` (default true)
